revenue.formula: (latest quarter revenue / same fiscal quarter prior-year revenue − 1) × 100

momentum.formula: median(latest 4 quarterly YoY growth rates) − median(preceding 4), pp; ±3 pp thresholds

revenue_consistency.formula: max absolute second difference ≤ max(3 pp, 25% of median absolute growth); or sustained level shift (≥3 quarters each side)

operating_margin.formula: latest quarter operating income / same-quarter revenue × 100

operating_margin_trend.formula: latest quarter operating margin − same fiscal quarter prior-year operating margin, pp

fcf_margin.formula: (TTM operating cash flow − TTM capex) / TTM revenue × 100

forward_pe.notes: Yahoo expected EPS per listed share in USD; estimate methodology is not independently verified.
forward_pe.formula: current price / sourced annual forward EPS
warnings: A positive sourced annual EPS estimate, identifiable forecast horizon, currency and estimate date are required; quote and estimate must be no older than seven days. Historical EPS extrapolation is excluded.

balance_sheet.formula: cash and cash equivalents − total debt; investments excluded
warnings: Net cash/debt requires unrestricted cash equivalents and complete compatible debt. Investments are excluded; inspect component definitions.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

warnings: Investment composition and liquidity require review; excluded from net cash.
Investment composition and liquidity require review; excluded from net cash.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

upcoming_earnings.notes: Days until the next expected earnings release window (2026-10-29) from Yahoo Finance/yfinance. This is an open/free market-calendar estimate and can change before the company confirms the date.
upcoming_earnings.formula: source event/window start date − current date

red_flag_count.notes: Potential concerns, not an investment-quality rating. Incomplete assessments have no numeric screening value.
red_flag_count.formula: One point per distinct flagged concern group; overlapping rules within a group count once.

checks.title: Persistent earnings-to-cash gap
checks.formula: TTM net income > 0 and TTM operating cash flow < TTM net income at both of the latest two quarter ends
checks.reason: Operating cash flow compared with positive reported earnings over two consecutive rolling TTM periods; working capital and non-cash items require context.

checks.title: Persistent negative free cash flow
checks.formula: Sum(operating cash flow − abs(capex)) < 0 in each of the latest two non-overlapping four-quarter periods
checks.reason: Free cash flow assessed over two non-overlapping years; investment spending can explain negative cash flow.

checks.title: Consecutive margin deterioration
checks.formula: Operating income / revenue is lower than the equivalent prior-year quarter in both latest quarters
checks.reason: Two consecutive year-over-year operating-margin comparisons; restructuring, investment and business mix can affect margins.

checks.title: Consecutive operating losses
checks.formula: Operating income < 0 in both latest quarters
checks.reason: Operating losses in consecutive quarters are a potential concern, including for businesses investing for growth.

checks.title: Negative book equity
checks.reason: Negative reported book equity; buybacks, distributions and accounting history can explain the deficit. This is not an insolvency finding.

checks.title: Priced for Perfection
checks.formula: Market cap / TTM revenue > 10 AND TTM (operating cash flow − abs(capex)) / same market cap < 0.02
checks.reason: Stock valuation is unusually high relative to current revenue and free cash flow generation. Initial screening heuristics, not universal valuation standards.

price_to_sales.formula: market capitalization / latest four reported quarters of revenue

fcf_yield.formula: sum(quarterly operating cash flow − abs(capex)) / same market capitalization × 100

screening.verification: Source identifiers preserve provenance; financial inputs have not been independently verified.

revenue_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

net_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

operating_cash_flow_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

capex_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

gross_profit_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable.

cost_of_revenue_ttm.notes: Latest annual SEC fact used because a same-year quarterly TTM bridge was unavailable.

operating_income_ttm.notes: TTM computed as latest annual fact plus latest year-to-date quarter minus prior-year matching year-to-date quarter.

shares_diluted.notes: Latest diluted weighted-average share count from SEC companyfacts; not a live shares-outstanding feed.

market_cap.notes: Current price multiplied by saved listing share count, including its ADR adjustment.

revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter YoY growth computed from reported Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from reported Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

gross_margin.notes: Latest-quarter gross_margin: Quarterly gross margin.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: Latest-quarter roic: Proxy annualized quarterly ROIC: operating income divided by quarter-end invested capital. No tax adjustment is applied.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

debt_to_equity.notes: Latest debt divided by latest stockholders' equity.

days_to_next_earnings.notes: Days until the next expected earnings release window (2026-10-29) from Yahoo Finance/yfinance. This is an open/free market-calendar estimate and can change before the company confirms the date.

pe.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved net_income in the listing currency.

forward_pe.notes: Yahoo expected EPS per listed share in USD; estimate methodology is not independently verified.
forward_pe.formula: current price / sourced annual forward EPS

peg.notes: Trailing P/E divided by saved 3-year EPS CAGR percentage.

price_to_sales.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved revenue in the listing currency.

ev_to_ebitda.notes: Current enterprise value divided by saved EBITDA in the listing currency.

fcf_yield.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved free_cash_flow in the listing currency.

free_cash_flow_ttm.notes: Operating cash flow TTM minus capex TTM. Capex is treated as a positive cash outflow.

fcf_margin_ttm.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

pe_ttm.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved net_income in the listing currency.

price_to_sales_ttm.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved revenue in the listing currency.

forward_pe_proxy.notes: Current price divided by the saved historical-growth EPS proxy.

forward_pe_public_estimate.notes: Current price divided by saved expected EPS from Yahoo or its implied forward P/E input; not an SEC fact.

peg_proxy.notes: Trailing P/E divided by saved 3-year EPS CAGR percentage.

eps_growth_3y_proxy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

ev_to_ebitda_proxy.notes: Current enterprise value divided by saved EBITDA in the listing currency.

ebitda_proxy.notes: Proxy EBITDA: operating income plus depreciation/amortization where SEC facts are available.

enterprise_value_proxy.notes: Current market cap plus saved debt minus saved cash in the listing currency.
